sections.name: About me
sections.text:
Hi! 
You can call me Aidi. I’m a children’s book illustrator and author residing in Araba (Basque country).  

I studied education, while I was working with children I fell in love with picture books and everything related to children’s books.  I decided to study illustration in 2021 (CMYK Bilbao) and since then I’ve been creating stories.

I always find inspiration in nature, seasons… but also in horror films and everyday life situations.  Spooky stories are my favorite!

As an illustrator I have worked with clients such as Denon Artean.

Exhibitions
Palestinarekin (2024), Haz laboratorio, Gazteiz

Erakusketa antiespezista (2025), Gasteiz

Drawn together (2026), The Cabin, Worcester
